This '''unidentified Weequay''' was an employee of [[Barrga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], and served him as an enforcer. The Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] sent the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] on a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] run during the [[Great Galactic War]] alongside the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Musk (Nikto)|Musk]]. The two of them were escorting the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] smuggler [[Hylo Visz]] to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where they were to deliver experimental [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]] to the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]]. During the job, Visz became skittish and attempted to bail on the operation, but was incapacitated by the Weequay, who struck the Mirialan in the face with his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. Visz later escaped the ship, but the Weequay and Musk completed the job, accepting the corporation's [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|payment]] in exchange for the ion drives. The two then took Visz's ship, the ''[[Crimson Fleece]]'', but were killed when the vessel exploded. The explosion was caused by bombs the Rendili Corporation had planted within their credit payments, in an effort to double-cross Barrga the Hutt.
